args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

The ToastProvider component currently uses a polite aria-live region and automatically dismisses toasts after 5 seconds, including error toasts. This causes screen readers to delay announcing errors and errors to vanish too quickly, matching the issue's description and showing the code responsible for this incorrect behavior.
